newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean police detain 106 Chinese smuggled on ship.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean police detain 106 Chinese smuggled on ship.

text.p: South Korean maritime police said on Friday that 106 Chinese nationals being smuggled into the country on two vessels had been detained off the south coast.

"The ethnic Korean Chinese nationals were on board two ships when the coast guard intercepted them" on Thursday night, said an official at the police headquarters in Koje, west of South Korea's largest port city Pusan.
The Chinese nationals were transferred to the Pusan maritime police where they would be questioned by police and intelligence officials, he said.
Pusan immigration officials said the detainees would be deported after the investigation.
Two South Koreans were also arrested for arranging the human smuggling, the Koje official said.
The number of ethnic Korean Chinese coming into South Korea in recent years has increased.
